exposure: Delivery in negative pressure isolated delivery rooms (NPIDRs) due to COVID-19 status
obstetric deliveries performed in negative pressure isolated delivery rooms (NPIDRs)
cohort: 213 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies at or after 34 weeks of gestation without major fetal anomalies
finding: Obstetric deliveries in NPIDRs for positive and suspected COVID-19 cases are associated with poorer short-term perinatal outcomes but not maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was not significantly different between deliveries in NPIDRs and CDRs.
